text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa, the grand finale of this 
year... I gave it every bit of my spirit. 
But—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
What's with this insane energy?! The 
crowd's passion is on a whole other level. 
So this is Ohi's Tokyo Daishoten!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Tarumae? Where's Tarumae...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: How far... did I manage to get?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder how well I did. Do you think 
people got to see a bit of who I am, 
coming all the way from Tomakomai?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I'm sure... everyone's favorite 
Umamusume are all scattered. But once I 
become the true Dirt Champion...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I can carry all these cheers 
back to Tomakomai. If I did... they'd 
really love it, wouldn't they?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Ricky-chan.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ah, Acute-san!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
What do you think, pretty amazing, right? 
This is the dirt year-end GⅠ~.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, how should I put it, it's amazing... 
or maybe a little too amazing.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Every single Umamusume runs with fierce 
passion. Yet the excitement of the crowd 
is so overwhelming, it swallows all of 
that right up~

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Wrapping this whole place up in one go is 
quite a tall order, you know."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
“You're right. No one has been able to 
dominate the field yet.”

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"I feel like both Tarumae and I are being 
dragged around, forced to run to their 
tune. Even so—"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Next year, I want to grow even more and 
return to this place!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
—The Year Pillar method. Next year's 
fortune will shift dramatically! So that 
this time, I can stand at the center of 
the vortex and overwhelm everyone.
